reasons: Cited text supports the compliant classification: 14.1 vests Customer Data, Customer Confidential Information and pre-existing/independent IP in Customer with only a limited processing right to Vendor; 14.2 contains a present assignment of Deliverables plus personnel assignments and further assurances; 14.3 limits Vendor to Vendor Technology and pulls in the 13.2 perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence (including modify/derivative works) for embedded Vendor Technology; 14.4 negates joint ownership absent a signed instrument and preserves Customer feedback rights.
No assignment of Customer IP/Data to Vendor and no joint ownership, so walk-away territory is not implicated; deterministic check confirms no residual assignment.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or counterparty comment is proposed and the paragraphs are unchanged.

The two caveats raised (Deliverable definition tied to Order Form identification; ownership conditioned on payment of Fees) are correctly treated as rationale notes rather than deviations, in line with the classification semantics.
